traits.name: Zealous Fury
traits.desc: When the Enforcer is reduced to half HP or lower, its melee attacks deal +1d6 damage until end of encounter.

actions.name: Weighted Club
actions.desc: Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit — 1d8+3 bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Threaten (recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: A creature within 10 ft. that can see and hear the Enforcer must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom save or be Frightened of it until the end of its next turn.
